verdict.rationale: The Entity Management API offers an 'API Extract for bulk retrieval'. It returns entity registry data as JSON or CSV, up to 1,000,000 records, and the extract URL can be delivered by email, so registry data is obtainable without scraping. However, it is an API-key-gated extract tied to a registered SAM.gov account rather than an openly published download, and bulk coverage for other datasets is unevidenced. Wage Determinations are only shown as a lookup page, and Opportunities, Exclusions and Contracts are shown only as search APIs. Missing for 10: keyless static bulk dataset files, bulk wage or contract statistics downloads, extract coverage beyond entity data, independent hands-on corroboration of the extract workflow.
